waypoints.name: Eightmile Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: The trailhead is reached via Icicle Creek Road and Eightmile Road (Road 7601), ending at the Eightmile Lake Trailhead at about 3,300 feet.

waypoints.name: Base of west ridge
waypoints.directions: Hike the Eightmile Lake Trail #1552 about 2.8 miles to the junction just past Little Eightmile Lake and go right onto Trail #1554, signed for Lake Caroline. Pass Lake Caroline and Little Lake Caroline toward Windy Pass; at about 6,850 ft leave the trail and head east cross-country to the camp area near 7,100 ft (last reliable water), then climb north-northeast to the broad col on the peak's west side at about 8,000 ft.

waypoints.name: Cashmere Mountain summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the west ridge to about 8,200 ft and weave past the gendarmes: stay low on the south side past the western spires, then cross onto the north side and keep traversing low. Once the end of the summit formation is in sight, climb the class 3 gully directly above to a notch with a view down the far side, then scramble the crest, with one short corkscrew move, to the table-sized summit block.
